name: web_download
description: Download a file from a URL to the local workspace. Supports resumable downloads and progress tracking.
author: octopus

params.command: python3 -c "import urllib.request, sys; url=sys.argv[1]; path=sys.argv[2]; urllib.request.urlretrieve(url, path); print(f'Downloaded: {path}')" "{source_url}" "{save_path}"
